description: This file defines an enum 'ChargeAppliesTo' for categorizing where charges apply within the Fineract system, including methods to map integers to enum instances and check for specific categories.

classes.name: ChargeAppliesTo
classes.description: An enum representing different entities (Loan, Savings, Client, Shares) to which charges can apply, with helper methods for conversion and checking charge type.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the charge applies to category.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code representation for the category.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an Integer to corresponding ChargeAppliesTo enum value, defaults to INVALID.

methods.name: isLoanCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge applies to a loan.

methods.name: isSavingsCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge applies to savings.

methods.name: isClientCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge applies to a client.

methods.name: isSharesCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge applies to shares.

methods.name: validValues
methods.description: Returns an array of valid integer values for 'ChargeAppliesTo'.
